messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated error rate and p99 spikes for /v1/generate (hosted, us-east-1). Start: 2026-03-14T17:11:02Z. Severity: P1.
sam (oncall): acked. taking lead. collecting scope.
maya (cs): customers flagging timeouts — 'Clariti' and 'Macro AI' reported increased latencies and some 502s. I have examples.
sam (oncall): thanks. @alex can you pull the runtime traces + KV metrics?
alex (runtime): pulling traces. initial glance: sudden growth in average sequence length + heavy concurrent sessions. Batcher pushed batching window which caused queues to spike; kvcache miss-rate increased and we saw GC pauses in quant runtime.
sasha (sre): scaling more nodes now and disabling batching autoscale to stop oscillation. posting progress.
sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) route affected traffic to last-known-good model variant; 2) disable aggressive quant compaction; 3) temporarily cap max-batch size. I'll enact route change.
sam (oncall): running API command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/routing/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","target":"redwood-stable-1","reason":"mitigate high p99"}'
```
ritesh (mlops): good. I'll also apply a conservative kvcache-ttl bump to reduce evictions for hosted pools.
alex (runtime): applied quick guard: when p95 > 600ms, skip quant compaction cycles. Monitoring for memory pressure.
sasha (sre): nodes added, traffic shifted. seeing p99 drop from ~2.4s to ~420ms within 6m. error rates down.
maya (cs): Clariti reports recovery; Macro AI still saw a few 502s but trending better.
sam (oncall): primary symptoms: (A) batcher aggressive growth due to short smoothing window; (B) kvcache churn under long-context workloads; (C) quant operator compaction causing per-thread stalls.
tori (pm): let's not call it resolved until we have a post-incident review. I'll set up the postmortem. Proposed slot: 2026-03-15 14:00 UTC.
ritesh (mlops): proposed remediations:
- set default batcher smoothing window to 45s (owner: sasha)
- conservative kvcache eviction + TTL fallback for hosted (owner: ritesh)
- add async compaction queue for quant operators w/ backoff (owner: alex)
- add canary for routing overrides so we can move 10% first (owner: infra team)
- automated customer notification template (owner: maya)

sam (oncall): adding temporary runbook note: when we see this combo (kv miss > 30% AND p99 > 1s) -> flip route + cap batch to 48.
alex (runtime): I'll also add more metrics to the traces: kv_hit_rate, batch_queue_ms, quant_pause_ms. That will help RCA.
sasha (sre): adding synthetic smoke that simulates 12k token sessions to our canary suite. alert when kv_hit_rate < 65% OR batch_queue_ms > 200ms.
maya (cs): I'll draft customer message now and send EOD. Will include who was affected and mitigation steps.
tori (pm): ensure sales and legal review the message for any SLA references.
sam (oncall): handoff: I'm on call for 45 more minutes, then @sasha will take over.
sasha (sre): taking over. will follow up on the PRs and monitors.
ritesh (mlops): I'll open PR for kvcache TTL change today and link incident id 3111112222. ETA for PR review: 2 days.
alex (runtime): plan for a staged fix: prototype async quant compaction in staging (owner: alex) -> perf test -> canary deploy to 10% -> full roll (target complete by 2026-04-05).
tori (pm): postmortem agenda in the doc: timeline, impact, root cause hypotheses, remediation plan + owners, customer comms, followups. Doc link: https://docs.redwood/incidents/3111112222-pm (please add notes).
sam (oncall): summary action items (initial):
- [1] increase batcher smoothing window to 45s + add canary throttles  owner: sasha  due: 2026-03-20
- [2] kvcache conservative evict policy + TTL fallback  owner: ritesh  due: 2026-03-18
- [3] async quant compaction w/ metrics  owner: alex  due: 2026-04-05
- [4] emergency route quick-toggle in console + audit log  owner: infra (alex liaise)  due: 2026-03-25
- [5] customer comms + impacted list  owner: maya  due: 2026-03-15 EOD
- [6] add long-context synthetic to canary suite  owner: sasha  due: 2026-03-22

maya (cs): I'll attach the customer impact list to the doc and note customers who want a follow-up call.
sasha (sre): monitors stable for 30min. moving incident to "mitigated" state in tracker, will not close until action items start.
sam (oncall): thanks everyone. if we see regression, re-pager and follow the emergency route playbook. :thumbsup:
tori (pm): good work. see you at the postmortem.
alex (runtime): I'll upload additional traces and the temporary instrumentation into the incident doc.
ritesh (mlops): PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1422 referencing 3111112222.
sasha (sre): will run a retrospective with infra tomorrow to tighten autoscaler params.
maya (cs): sending customer notes now.
sam (oncall): signing off, handoff complete.
